glossary.definition: (1) "Commercial sex act" means any sex act on account of which anything of value is directly or indirectly given, promised to, or received by any person.
glossary.source_title: Section 109.66 - Publication of statistical data on trafficking in persons.

glossary.definition: (2) "Labor" means work of economic or financial value.
glossary.source_title: Section 109.66 - Publication of statistical data on trafficking in persons.

glossary.definition: (3) "Services" means an ongoing relationship between persons in which a person performs activities at the behest of, under the supervision of, or for the benefit of another person.
glossary.source_title: Section 109.66 - Publication of statistical data on trafficking in persons.

glossary.definition: (4) "Sexually explicit performance" means a live, public, private, photographed, recorded, or videotaped act intended to sexually arouse, satisfy the sexual desires of, or appeal to the prurient interests of any person.
glossary.source_title: Section 109.66 - Publication of statistical data on trafficking in persons.

glossary.definition: (5) "Human trafficking" has the same meaning as in section 2929.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 109.66 - Publication of statistical data on trafficking in persons.

title: Section 109.66 - Publication of statistical data on trafficking in persons.
